title: Quiz: HTML Forms Security
description: Check your understanding of HTML Forms Security.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: Why is server-side validation still needed when HTML5 has built-in checks?
options: Client validation can be bypassed — the server must enforce rules
questions.correctAnswer: Client validation can be bypassed — the server must enforce rules
questions.explanation: Anyone can craft requests without a browser.

questions.question: True or False: A CSRF token proves a form submission originated from your site.
Fill in the blank: escape user input to prevent ${xss} attacks
questions.explanation: Unescaped <script> in user text executes in victims' browsers.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
